## Surge scenario (LOW surges to 2000 kbps between t=10 s and t=25 s)

| mode | HIGH loss % | HIGH avg delay ms (whole run) | HIGH avg delay ms (during surge) | LOW loss % |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fifo | 12.8 | 752.7 | 1929.8 | 31.0 |
| static | 0.0 | 1.9 | 2.3 | 41.0 |
| adaptive | 0.0 | 5.9 | 12.3 | 43.6 |

Adaptive controller: priority ON at t = 10.5 s, OFF at t = 28.6 s (surge was 10 s - 25 s).

## Live policy change (REST call at t = 15 s)

Before = from t = 3 s to the change; after = from 8 s after the change to the end (once the packets already queued under the old policy have drained).

| flow | throughput before (kbps) | throughput after (kbps) | delay before (ms) | delay after (ms) |

| h1 udp/5001 HIGH->LOW | 805 | 523 | 3.2 | 7562.3 |
| h2 udp/5002 MEDIUM | 403 | 400 | 6.5 | 15.4 |
| h3 udp/5003 LOW->HIGH | 571 | 800 | 2365.6 | 5.9 |
